cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:8b2.title: Chef Instructor, Pastry (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:8b2.team: 089 - City Center - Sur La Table, 816 Town & Country Blvd suite 123, Houston, TX 77024
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:8b2.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Pastry at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things baking and pastry arts. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Deliver an exceptional in-store culinary experience focused on pastry and baking classes that reflects Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following the provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality. · Communicate technical concepts and advanced pastry skills in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class. · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). distro-distro:lever:897ee24b-b30b-4900-b.description: We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Licensed Insurance Sales Producer to join our growing Farmers Insurance agency. In this role, you will be responsible for generating new business, supporting existing clients, and contributing to the overall growth of the agency. This is an excellent opportunity for a sales professional who enjoys building relationships, closing deals, and helping clients make informed insurance decisions. Responsibilities Present and explain insurance coverage options based on clients' needs and risk profiles Meet or exceed new business production goals Prospect and generate new business through leads and referrals Build and maintain strong client relationships for retention and cross-selling Follow up with clients to ensure satisfaction and resolve concerns Stay up to date on insurance products, underwriting guidelines, and coverage updates Accurately document client interactions and sales activities in agency systems Requirements Active Texas Property & Casualty License (General Lines or Personal Lines) – Required Life, Accident & Health License – Preferred (not required) Previous sales or customer-facing experience preferred Strong communication, organization, and follow-up skills Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Self-motivated with strong accountability and sense of urgency Availability to work full-time, in-office (Monday–Friday) Must pass a background check (state, federal, and county) #HireFinder #LI-Onsite

flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:6862.title: Traveling - Metal Walls & Roof Panels - Fort Worth
flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:6862.description: Job Summary: Installation of Architectural Cladding applications, including Steel Roofing and Wall finishes, Composite Aluminum Wall finishes, Composite Aluminum Wall panels and Custom Zinc or Copper applications. Install exterior metal products according to specifications and building codes. Install, repair and service exterior prefabricated products. This position will require travel to project sites across Texas, including Amarillo, Abilene, and San Antonio, as well as Monroe, Louisiana. Flynn will provide housing accommodation. What We Offer • Competitive Wages $24 - $33 DOE! + $40 perdiem when traveling. • Multiple wage reviews throughout the year • Comprehensive PAID benefits - health, dental, and vision • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance • Life and AD&D Insurance • 401k w/ company match • Opportunities for career advancement • Mobile apps and training programs are available to help you further your skills What We Are Seeking Foreman level: 5+ years of experience with architectural metals in a commercial/industrial setting. 2-3 years of metals foreman experience. Apprentice to Journeyman: • 2+ years of experience with architectural metals in a commercial/industrial setting. (Required) • Coping and cap metal jobs experience. • 3-5 years’ commercial cladding experience. • Experience with various architectural metal wall panel systems & metal roofing installations. • Standing Seam Metal Wall and Roof Panels. • Install Architectural Wall Panel applications. • Fabricate or alter parts at construction sites, using shears, hammers, punches, or drills. • Install wall panel products according to specifications and building codes. • Drill and punch holes in metal, for screws, bolts, and rivets. • Maneuver units into position for installation and anchor the units. • Secure metal panels in place, and interlock and fasten grooved panel edges. • Fasten seams or joints together with welds, bolts, cement, rivets, solder, caulks, metal drive clips, or bonds to assemble and repair components. #LI-DNI 04/23/26

ghj-ghj:lever:8235257b-16df-4e28-b09d-10.title: Senior Accountant
ghj-ghj:lever:8235257b-16df-4e28-b09d-10.description: GHJ Search and Staffing serves as the recruitment division of GHJ, a prominent national accounting and advisory firm. Our team provides qualified Accounting and Finance professionals on a temporary and permanent basis across a broad range of industries. GHJ’s relationship with our Global Advisory and Accounting Network provides the resources needed to better understand client’s needs, attract a higher caliber of candidates and assess candidate potential. About the Opportunity A rapidly expanding company in the entertainment and technology sector is seeking an experienced and highly organized Senior Accountant to join its finance team. This role offers an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Reporting directly to the Accounting Manager and Director of Treasury, the Senior Accountant will play an essential role in maintaining accurate financial records, overseeing billing and collections, and supporting month-end closing and audit activities. Primary Responsibilities Oversee customer invoicing and monitor automated billing systems to ensure accuracy and consistency. Manage the full accounts receivable cycle, including payment posting and reconciliation. Partner closely with the Treasury team to confirm proper application of payments and resolve discrepancies. Maintain general ledger entries for AR activity and assist with period-end closing processes. Conduct regular account reconciliations and assist with internal and external audit requests. Generate and analyze reports to support financial decision-making. Communicate professionally with customers regarding payment status, billing inquiries, or account issues. Contribute to process improvements and efficiency initiatives within the accounting department. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (required). CPA certification preferred, but not mandatory. 2–5 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in accounts receivable or general ledger functions. Familiarity with ERP systems such as NetSuite and payment platforms like Bill.com is a plus. Experience working across multiple business units or entities is highly valued. Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and confidentiality. What We Offer A collaborative and growth-oriented work environment. The opportunity to contribute directly to a company experiencing strong expansion. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

ghj-ghj:lever:c74481cb-af9a-4c79-a0c1-fa.title: Executive Recruiter, Accounting & Finance
ghj-ghj:lever:c74481cb-af9a-4c79-a0c1-fa.description: GHJ is looking for an Executive Recruiter WHY we get up in the morning At GHJ we help our people and clients pursue their passions, build thriving businesses, and create a better future. WHAT we believe We believe that collaboration is the foundation for success. We work as a business advocate for our clients – providing personalized service and building long-term relationships to help position our clients for the future. HOW we succeed We are deeply committed to our core values of Bright Minds, Brave Hearts and Bold Actions and incorporate them into every aspect of our business. By living these values, we are able to meet our strategic objectives of Remaining Fiercely Independent (financial success), Meeting client demands/needs (client success), Reinforcing and expanding cultural distinction (people success). Summary of Role: GHJ Search and Staffing is the recruitment division of GHJ, a national accounting and advisory firm. Our Search and Staffing team specializes in linking proficient accounting and finance professionals with temporary, interim, and direct-hire positions across a wide range of industries. With the support of the Global Advisory and Accounting Network, we have the essential resources to grasp client needs, attract top-tier talent, and effectively evaluate candidate potential. The Executive Recruiter will be responsible for sourcing, recruiting and onboarding finance/accounting professionals. This includes partnering with hiring managers, identifying candidates through social sourcing, job placement ads, and other research methods. This role will handle all pre-screening and interviewing of candidates, developing an applicant pipeline and taking candidates through the entire recruitment cycle. You will be the "matchmaker" between people and career opportunities, building long-standing relationships with both candidates and clients. The Executive Recruiter will work closely with our Business Development Managers (direct-hire and temporary) to match the requirements of each client need.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:49c58395-ac2a-.title: Marketing Specialist - Forex / Fintech
jobgether-jobgether:lever:49c58395-ac2a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Marketing Specialist - Forex / Fintech based in Germany. This role offers the opportunity to drive digital marketing initiatives within a fast-growing international Forex and Fintech environment. You will take ownership of campaigns across paid media, social platforms, affiliate networks and other digital channels. Working closely with sales and product teams, you will connect marketing execution with broader commercial and growth objectives. Your work will contribute to strengthening brand visibility, improving campaign performance and supporting expansion into international markets. The position combines creativity with a strong data-driven approach, requiring you to continuously analyse results and optimise performance. You will also operate within a regulated financial environment, ensuring marketing activities meet applicable advertising and compliance standards. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced marketing professional who wants meaningful ownership, international exposure and the chance to influence global growth. Plan, launch, manage and continuously optimise digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok and other relevant paid media platforms. Develop and coordinate social media content, including planning, scheduling and execution, to increase brand awareness and audience engagement. Manage affiliate and Introducing Broker marketing channels, building and maintaining productive relationships with partners and influencers. Support influencer marketing initiatives and identify relevant partnership opportunities that can expand reach and customer acquisition. Monitor campaign performance, analyse KPIs and prepare regular reports to identify trends, measure ROI and inform optimisation decisions. Collaborate closely with sales and product teams to ensure marketing initiatives support commercial priorities and broader growth objectives. Ensure digital campaigns and promotional content comply with applicable financial advertising and regulatory requirements, including relevant ESMA and FCA standards. Identify opportunities to strengthen the brand's presence and customer acquisition strategy across international markets, particularly in SEA, MENA and LatAm. Contribute to content marketing, SEO/SEM and localisation initiatives where relevant to regional growth strategies. Requirements 3–5 years of marketing experience within Forex, CFD, Fintech, financial services or a closely related industry. Strong hands-on experience with paid advertising platforms such as Google Ads, Meta and TikTok. Proven experience managing social media channels and developing or coordinating digital content. Practical experience with affiliate, Introducing Broker and influencer marketing campaigns. Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to interpret campaign KPIs and use performance insights to optimise marketing activities. Good understanding of digital acquisition, campaign optimisation and brand growth strategies. Excellent communication, organisation and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and take ownership of campaigns from planning through execution and optimisation. Familiarity with SEO/SEM within the financial services sector is an advantage. Knowledge of financial marketing compliance requirements, including ESMA and FCA standards, is highly desirable. Experience supporting campaigns across SEA, MENA or LatAm markets is a plus. Additional language skills and experience with content localisation are advantageous. Benefits Competitive annual salary of €32,000–€46,000. Fully remote working arrangement. Opportunity to work within an international Forex and Fintech environment. Exposure to global digital marketing campaigns and international growth initiatives. Significant ownership and responsibility for shaping paid,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ac9a9801-2c96-.title: Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ac9a9801-2c96-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer, Backend - Data Layer based in Switzerland. As a Backend Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you’ll help build and evolve the storage and query infrastructure behind a large-scale process orchestration platform. You’ll work across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch to keep process data reliable, performant, and available. Your work will directly support capabilities ranging from process monitoring to emerging AI-driven automation experiences. You’ll tackle complex challenges around data storage, retention, streaming, secondary storage, and scalability. The role offers strong ownership, with opportunities to shape technical solutions from requirements through production delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, QA, SRE, Support, and fellow engineers in a remote-first environment. It’s an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a sophisticated backend platform while growing your expertise in data-intensive systems. Design, build, and maintain backend services responsible for storing and serving process data across relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a strong focus on correctness, performance, reliability, and scalability. Own engineering initiatives end to end, translating product requirements into technical designs, breaking complex work into actionable tasks, and driving delivery to a high standard. Help evolve how process data is processed, retained, exposed, and streamed so customers can access and use their data effectively. Improve the performance and scalability of secondary storage systems as platform usage grows, while developing tooling that supports observability, troubleshooting, and safe production operations. Investigate and resolve complex data-layer production issues, including slow queries, indexing problems, and execution-plan challenges, as part of L3 support and on-call rotations. Partner with Product Management, Support, SRE, QA, and other engineering teams to ensure technical solutions meet customer needs and production requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement by bringing lessons from production incidents and customer feedback back into engineering practices and product development. Requirements: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Backend Software Engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores. Hands-on experience with at least one major database or search technology such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MSSQL, Elasticsearch, or OpenSearch. Practical understanding of query performance, indexing strategies, data modeling, execution plans, and the trade-offs involved in designing data-intensive systems. Demonstrated experience contributing to complex engineering initiatives, including requirements analysis, technical design, task decomposition, implementation, and reliable delivery. Ability to troubleshoot data-related production issues and investigate slow queries, index usage, and other performance bottlenecks. Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly in a remote-first environment, with the ability to work effectively with Product and engineering stakeholders and provide and receive constructive code-review feedback. Willingness to use and understand the product as part of developing customer-focused solutions. Experience with workflow automation, process orchestration, or developer platforms is a plus. Experience working across both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch is advantageous. Familiarity with CI pipelines and database migration or schema-evolution tools such as Liquibase or Flyway is beneficial. Benefits: Competitive, transparent, location-based compensation, with the applicable range determined by skills, experience, and location. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f34af730-0837-.title: Sr. Client Coordinator (E-Commerce)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f34af730-0837-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Client Coordinator (E-Commerce) based in United States. As a Sr. Client Coordinator, you will take ownership of complex client relationships and e-commerce content projects from initial planning through final publication and syndication. You will coordinate cross-functional activities, manage project schedules, and ensure client requirements and brand standards are consistently met. The role sits at the intersection of client service, project management, digital shelf content, and production operations. You will serve as a key point of contact for client questions, project updates, production issues, and problem resolution. Success requires strong organization, communication, analytical thinking, and the ability to keep multiple priorities moving in a fast-paced environment. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on client satisfaction and the successful delivery of digital commerce content. Own complex and/or multiple client relationships while serving as the project owner for e-commerce content from project initiation through completion. Create and maintain detailed project work-back schedules, ensuring upfront tasks, milestones, and activities are assigned and completed on time. Initiate project kickoff and solution review meetings and coordinate follow-up meetings, deliverables, and activities according to project requirements. Direct project activities and monitor progress to maintain cost, quality, and timeline efficiencies. Engage directly with clients to understand expectations, validate protocols and brand requirements, and ensure compliance throughout the project lifecycle. Serve as a primary point of contact for client inquiries, providing timely responses regarding project status, reports, concerns, and information requests. Monitor production queries, identify potential conflicts or delays, and coordinate effective resolutions to keep projects on track. Apply knowledge of digital shelf processes, from creative kickoff through publication and content syndication, to support successful e-commerce content delivery. Interpret client needs and translate requirements into clear project actions for internal teams and stakeholders. Identify and resolve project issues proactively, escalating risks when necessary to protect timelines, quality, and client satisfaction. Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal colleagues, external clients, and other project stakeholders. Support additional project coordination and operational activities as assigned. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 3+ years of progressive project coordination experience, preferably in a client-facing or production environment. Understanding of digital shelf content requirements and e-commerce content processes is preferred. Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage projects from conception through completion. Excellent analytical, prioritization, planning, budgeting, and problem-solving abilities. Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to analyze, interpret, and communicate complex information clearly. High proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, internet applications, and related business tools. Strong interpersonal and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively with clients, peers, and management. Ability to develop and maintain productive collaborative relationships across internal and external teams. Ability to influence peers and management while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Highly self-motivated and organized, with exceptional attention to detail, deadlines, project status, and reporting. Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
